rows.en: "Go on and blast that Regis bastard to kingdom come!"
"This is the last fight. Go shake it off!"
"You'd better come back alive, no matter what!!"
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yes! We'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
I will live. I'll live, and I'll come back!!
Don't worry... I... I won't die!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, you just wait! We're comin' back, count on it!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, we'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, I'll come back, without fail!!
Yeah, wait for me! I'll come back alive, no matter what!!
Yeah, I'll come back, without fail!!
"If only this body could move, I'd be rushin' over there too... Pathetic, man..."
"It'll be all right. All of you have a 'heart of justice.' That's why you're sure to win!"
"Follow your emotions... That's the right path. Isn't it...?"
"Sorry. Even I can't aim and fire from way out here. But I believe in ya. You guys can do this!!"
"I'm sorry I can't help you... Save the world in our place!!"
Everyone... I've received those feelings... 00, eliminating the target!!
You guys... Leave it to me!! I'm gonna crush Regis myself!!
Everyone... thank you... All right!! Let's go!!
Everyone... please leave it to me!! I'll put a stop to Regis's ambitions!!
You guys... Leave it to us!! We're the ones who'll take Regis down!!
Everyone... thanks... I've taken your feelings to heart!! Leave the rest to me!!
Everyone... I have received all your feelings. I will surely shatter Regis's ambitions!!
You guys!! Who d'ya think I am!? I'm at my climax till the very, very end!!!
Everyone... all your feelings... will flow through this body of mine and become power!!
Everyone... I've received those feelings. I'll defeat Regis, no matter what!!
Everyone... I have received all your feelings. I'll be the one to defeat Regis!!
Everyone... I've received those feelings. I'll defeat Regis, no matter what!!
Everyone... I've received those feelings. I'll defeat Regis, no matter what!!
Everyone... I have received all your feelings. I will surely shatter Regis's ambitions!!
The walls, the floor... Are they all formed out of Minus Energy?

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0734.bla. Block #16-30 = TextIdOffset+15+R1, first Pt_Chara_Check chain: W, Zero, God Gundam, Mebius, Den-O, OOO, Zeta, Nu, Black RX, Rider 1, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, 00, Wing Zero. So #26-28 = Taro/Ultraman/Seven (with '!'), #29-30 = 00/Wing Zero (no '!', flatter English). Reply to Zoffy and Hikari's comm send-off (#13-14, story_170); 'we' because the leader speaks for the team entering the gate. Keep in step with story_170's rendering of the identical line at #18/#21/#23-25.

Birth (CHARA_NAME 78), Accel (33), Methuss (34) confirmed by script. Lines in corner brackets are remote voices; double quotes as for comm lines in story_169. 'Regis bastard' renders the insult suffix; Regis is gender-neutral (g n).
Accel's catchphrase verb (shake it off) kept per glossary note; 'this is the last one' read as the final fight.

Block #37-51 is NEVER played: the script runs the second Pt_Chara_Check chain (Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, 00, Wing Zero, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Den-O, Black RX, Rider 1, God Gundam, Zeta, Nu) but no MessWinSet uses TextIdOffset+36+R1. Translated anyway with that order (wording matches it: #38 polite Mebius, #41 Setsuna, #42 Heero, #46 Momotaros, #50 Kamille). Unmarked subject rendered 'we' (answering Methuss's plea to all); #41/#42/#49/#50/#51 have an explicit first-person 'I'.
Deathscythe Hell (74), Sandrock (76), Heavyarms (75), Cherudim (71), Arios (72) confirmed by script; extracted labels correct. Remote voices in double quotes; Quatre's quoted term in single quotes.
Trowa echoes Heero's famous creed about acting on one's emotions, hence 'Isn't it...?'.
Lockon: his 'aim and fire' catchphrase verb kept ('Aiming and firing!' per glossary).

Block #60-74 = TextIdOffset+59+R1, third chain: 00, Zero, OOO, Wing Zero, Mebius, W, God Gundam, Taro, Den-O, Zeta, Seven, Black RX, Nu, Ultraman, Rider 1. Extracted '?party' on #60 = 00. The source's pronoun for the enemy is rendered 'Regis' throughout (gender-neutral, clear referent). #60 uses the established '00, eliminating the target'.
W speaks as Shotaro and Philip: 'us'/'we' follows the plural pronoun in the source.
Momotaros: climax catchphrase variant ('at my climax till the very, very end').
Kamille: Zeta channels people's feelings into power through his body (bio-sensor theme).

Block #79-93 and #95-109 = TextIdOffset+78+R1 / +94+R1, fourth chain: Rider 1, Ultraman, Nu, Black RX, Seven, Zeta, Den-O, Taro, God Gundam, W, Mebius, Wing Zero, OOO, Zero, 00. All #79-93 identical. 'So this is it...' matches story_122.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36), between the two leader blocks.
Den-O (Momotaros), index 6 of the fourth chain: rough wording in the source, hence the different line.
0736.bla: TextIdOffset+0+R2, chain order Zero, OOO, 00, Mebius, W, Wing Zero, Taro (#1-7), continuing into story_172. All identical; the party arrives inside and asks if this is where Regis is.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0734.bla/0736.bla; four different leader orders in 0734. Block #37-51 is never played by the script (chain 2 set but unused); translated with that order. Enemy pronoun rendered as 'Regis'. No new names or terms.
